mapper.insert: insert into erp_supplier (supplier_code, supplier_name, credit_code, supplier_category, contact_name, contact_phone, email, address, bank_name, bank_account, tax_no, admission_status, risk_level, owner_id, admission_time, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{supplierCode}, #{supplierName}, #{creditCode}, #{supplierCategory}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{taxNo}, #{admissionStatus}, #{riskLevel}, #{ownerId}, #{admissionTime}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_supplier where id in #{id}
